english.title: Use / cause / permit vehicle to be used at Stansted Airport London - passengers compromised / dangerous load
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..)

(A)_[used a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_
(B)_[caused a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), to be used]_
(C)_[permitted a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), to be used]_

at **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..) to which the road traffic enactments do not apply, at Stansted Airport London when the

(D)_[vehicle and all parts and accessories of the vehicle were not in such condition]_
(E)_[number of passengers carried by the vehicle was not such]_
(F)_[manner in which passengers were carried in or on the vehicle was not such]_
(G)_[weight, distribution, packing and adjustment of the load of the vehicle was not such]_

that no danger was caused or was likely to be caused to any person in or on the vehicle or on the Airport
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 5(8)(a) and 2(3) of the Stansted Airport - London Byelaws, 1996 and section 63 of the Airports Act 1986.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
use / cause / permit a vehicle to be used
at a location
to which the road traffic enactments do not apply
at Stansted Airport London
when the vehicle and all parts and accessories
of the vehicle were not in such condition OR
when the number of passengers
carried by the vehicle was not such OR
when the manner in which passengers were carried
in / on the vehicle was not such OR
when the weight / distribution / packing / adjustment
of the load of the vehicle was not such
that no danger was caused / was likely to be caused
to a person in / on the vehicle / on the Airport.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) This Byelaw applies to any part of the Airport to which the road traffic enactments do not apply.
(ii) For insecure load see H7929 (SA96059).
